text.description_html:
Emtek BTB-76031, Normandy Wrought Steel Back-to-Back Pulls

The Normandy Wrought Steel Door Pull Pair comes packaged with 2 pulls and the hardware needed to back-to-back mount them. These traditional pulls will fit doors 1-3/8 inches to 2-1/4 inches thick. The 8 inch Normandy Wrought Steel Back-to-Back Pull Set is available in flat black steel or satin steel finishes. The barrel middle design is a classic--perfectly suited to match almost any traditional home decor.

Back-to-Back Mounting: Pulls bolt to each other through the door. Packaged with 2 door pulls (1 door pull for each side of a door).

Also Available: Normandy Pull with Thru-Bolt Mounting

Specifications of the Emtek Normandy Barrel Middle Pull Set:

  • Material: Wrought Steel
  • Total Length: 8-13/16"
  • Center to Center Length: 8"
  • Pull Handle Width: 1-5/16"
  • Total Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Base: 3/4"
  • Door Thickness: for doors 1-3/8" to 2-1/4" thick.
  • Includes installation hardware required for fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.

Sold as a Pair (2 Door Pulls) with Back-to-Back mounting.
